family.description: This entry represents the C-terminal domain found in the Pseudomonas bacteriophage E217 tail sheath protein gp31 and related proteins, including phage Pa193 gp32 and Shigella flexneri bacteriophage Sf14 gp39. This domain adopts an alpha/beta structure which has similarity to domains, members of the GpW/Gp25-like domain superfamily [[cite:PUB00163741],[cite:PUB00163742],[cite:PUB00153918]].
family.name: E217 tail sheath protein gp31-like, C-terminal domain
